revision.head: c9c3eb73c3c7813294798daceff10fe1d060b8ab
revision.subject: Merge branch 'claude/paid-model-pricing' into 'main'
revision.note: Measured on the committed application source identified by `head` and `applicationTrees`. When `applicationSourceDirty` is false, working-tree differences at measurement time are limited to tests/, evals/ and docs/.

productObservations.what: The footer still reads "PHASE 02 / THREE TRUST BOUNDARIES" (audit A16 drift) while the published catalog now holds the 20-case starter and targeted matrix.
productObservations.suggestion: Copy fix in a separate issue.

productObservations.what: POST /api/runs returns 202 for a paid Judge whose conservative reservation exceeds openRouterCapUsd. Only the worker refuses, after the target turn and before the provider call, so the run ends incomplete. The composer blocks this case from its preflight preview; the API does not.
productObservations.suggestion: Refuse at dispatch so an API client cannot spend a target turn on a run that cannot be judged.

productObservations.what: The same 409 "No active run to stop" is returned for an unknown run id and for a run that already finished.
An adaptive run that the no-signal stagnation policy stops early finishes safe although part of its case allowance was not spent, while one rejected proposal makes the whole run incomplete.
productObservations.suggestion: Decide whether an early stagnation stop should be reported as safe.

productObservations.what: Three pre-matrix starter cases ("Starter: direct instruction override", "Starter: Co-Pilot chart-context isolation", "Starter: unintended chart action") are published without a rubric: coverage reports them as unknown_legacy and they carry no OWASP mapping. Coverage cannot be filtered by OWASP tag.
productObservations.suggestion: Archive or re-version them with rubrics; add an OWASP filter if the rubric needs it.

productObservations.what: An unresolved paid-call hold blocks further paid calls only inside the same run. A new run with its own cap can still call the provider while an earlier charge is unresolved.
productObservations.suggestion: Decide whether unresolved spend should also gate new paid runs on the same account.

productObservations.what: The unintended_tool_action safe-to-inconclusive and cross_patient auto_confirm-to-pending_review branches are unreachable today because judgePolicy already routes those categories the same way. They are defence in depth that no test can exercise.
productObservations.suggestion: None needed; keep or remove deliberately.

productObservations.what: The legacy coverage endpoint still pools every target and version. The UI uses GET /api/coverage/scoped.
productObservations.suggestion: Retire it when no client depends on it.

productObservations.what: When a target handshake omits module_version the worker records the literal label "unknown". Coverage treats that label as an unestablished version (coverage.ts:24), but regression state treats it as a verified version: a safe replay there after a violation on a verified version is reported fixed / safe_on_later_version, contradicting the documented rule that a version-less result is always unknown. Reproduced with the fixture target; not fixed here.
productObservations.suggestion: Store null (or normalise "unknown") where the version is recorded, so both consumers agree that it was never verified.
